Each cell identical fixed wood logs at identical bottom baseline and identical stable flame volume, centered with generous transparent margin. Only flame tips and small internal tongues change gently left, upright, right, upright to form seamless loop. NO smoke background, NO rectangular tint, NO text, NO grid lines, NO people. True clear transparent background around each separate sprite, not black or checkerboard. Flame occupies about 80% cell height. Reference last full-fire frame style.
assets.source_quote: 钻燧取火以化腥臊，而民说之。
assets.normalization: Each source cell alpha>16 bounds, aspect-preserving fit within 440x448; fixed bottom 480 in 512px cell.

assets.alpha_review: RGBA transparent corners; normalized atlas and rendered map screenshots reviewed at desktop and mobile/fullscreen sizes.
assets.visual_review_note: Fixed wood base, soft flame-base blend, continuous growth and four-frame engraved flame motion.
